== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Probe Antennae (Japanese)|Probe Antennae]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154943998/ZsR7r9BBhUiGrJHaWBwFHg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099869.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0cfad69933ae96d99efae3ddd48f6a631a1bc2a13153f7c02ba8663ac6e4f31c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
